short_description: Our serve-and-return logo on a soft-colored adult unisex tee. 4 colors, XS-3XL, printed when you order. Grown-up sizes only.
long_description:
The Play Before Pixels logo tee is for the grown-ups who sit on the floor, build the tower and wait for the answer.

Our mark is the P of Play. A ball comes back to close it, like the serve and return of talk and play: a grown-up says something, and a child answers. The small gap before the ball is the pause that gives the child a turn. It sits high on the chest, about 10.5 inches wide, in ink with a tomato-red ball, or in white with the same ball on navy.

Choose White, Natural, Mustard or Navy in adult unisex sizes XS to 3XL. Your size and care details are printed inside the neck.

Each tee is printed when you order it by our print partner and shipped to you with tracking, so allow a few extra days before it ships. Nothing sits in a warehouse.

We make grown-up sizes only. We don't make kids' clothing.

Care: machine wash cold, inside out; tumble dry low; don't iron the print.

Looking for a gift? It pairs well with our picture book The Day the Tablet Slept and our 150 "I'm bored!" Play Cards, sold separately.
